## Objective

A session can confirm it is talking to the genuine service and that no other server shadows the connector.

## Scope

As stated in the objective and acceptance criteria; nothing beyond them.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] The check reports the server identity it reached and fails on a mismatch
- [ ] a locally configured server with the same name or URL is reported
- [ ] the check sends no knowledge before identity is confirmed

## Test requirements

Scripted trial against a local test server.

## Deliverables

Code or configuration, tests, and updated documentation for this ticket.
